Visualize FVS Message Frequencies

plot_FVS_messages.Rd

Visualize FVS Message Frequencies

Usage

plot_FVS_messages(out_dir, out_db, stand_df, verbose = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

out_dir

Character string. Location of the output database. Defaults to working directory.

out_db

Character string. Name of the FVS output database. Defaults to 'FVSOut.db', matching the default in write_FVS_key().

stand_df

Dataframe. Stand information for stands run through FVS. Errors will only be reported for stands that appear in this dataframe. Requires a column named "STAND_ID" (matching STDIDENT passed to write_FVS_files).

verbose

Boolean. If TRUE, unique error messages will be printed to the console. Default FALSE.

...

Optional parameters to pass to plot(). Only used if ggplot is not installed.

Value

If ggplot2 is installed, a ggplot object. Otherwise, a plot on the current base R plotting device.
